verdicts.reason: A breaks reading order: the opening quote mark sits after the quote. The quote is squeezed into 4 tiny lines jammed against the left edge, and the SOLSTICE logo is an illegible speck beside the shrunken glass. B keeps the quote mark before a 3-line quote and gives the attribution its own column, so it reads left to right. Its flaws: the logo is a near-invisible floating speck, the glass is cropped at the bottom-right edge, and the quote text is still very small at 50px tall.
